name: dashboardSysId
label: Dashboard Sys Id
description: Sys ID of dashboard to open

name: editMode
label: Edit Mode
description: Open dashboard in edit mode

name: tabSysId
label: Tab Sys Id
description: Sys ID of dashboard tab to open

name: userInfo
label: User Info
description: User information from the User session object

name: defaultDrilldowns
label: Use default redirections
description: Use default redirection (not applicable to dashboards created in UI Builder)

name: hideHeader
label: Disable the whole header
description: Users do not see the header, but only the dashboard content

name: hideDashboardPicker
label: Hide dashboard picker
description: Hide the dashboard picker on all dashboards in the workspace.

name: hideShareButton
label: Disable sharing
description: Hide the Share button on this dashboard. Other users are not able to share it.

name: hideEditButton
label: Disable editing
description: Hide the Edit button on this dashboard. Other users are not able to edit it.

name: hideCreateNewButton
label: Disable dashboard creation
description: Users do not see the Create new button and are not able to create new dashboards.

name: useAsEmbedded
label: Use as embedded
description: When true, the dashboard can be embedded in a configurable workspace. The Copy URL and Copy URL with filter options are not available on embedded dashboards.

name: delegateUrlParams
label: Delegate URL params
description: When true, URL parameters are not updated directly. Instead DASHBOARD#URL_PARAMS_UPDATE_REQUESTED is dispatched so the parent page can manage URL state.

name: queryInactive
label: Query inactive dashboard
description: When true, the dashboard sys ID provided can be an inactive dashboard, and the editor will render it.

name: defaultDashboard
label: Default Dashboard
description: Dashboard to be opened when user does not pick a dashboard.

name: experienceId
label: User Info
description: User information from the User session object

name: showPrintPreview
label: Show dashboard in print preview mode
description: Set to true when dashboard is being exported as a PDF/Image

name: exportMode
label: Export Mode
description: Select between `WYSIWYG` and `paged` export view

name: filterId
label: Shareable Filter Sys ID
description: The sysId of the persisted filter set up of a dashboard

name: element
label: Breakdown element
description: Allows the setting of the breakdown element, if applicable for the selected dashboard

name: globalFilters
label: Global filters
description: Global filters are sent to the dashboard serve as filters for the visualizations within the dashboard. These filters are merged with existing filters on the dashboard. The format of JSON is {encodedQueries: {table1: 'query', table2: 'query'}, parFilters: 'PAR Filters'}. Both encodedQueries and filters are transformed into PAR filters internally and merged with existing filters in dashboard.

name: globalProperties
label: Global Properties
description: Global properties that are added to all components

name: unifiedFiltersParam
label: Unified Filters
description: Unified filters passed via URL parameters to the dashboard.

name: drilldownToCoreUI
label: Drilldown to Core UI
description: When checked, the drilldowns from visualizations based on table data source redirects to Core UI list and form. Otherwise, dashboard redirects to 'simplelist' page if it exists in workspace.

name: useDataBroker
label: Use data broker to fetch data
description: Use data broker to fetch dashboard metadata. Use 'Data broker response' property to bind the data broker response.

name: data
label: Data broker response
description: Data broker response for the dashboard.
